probing_questions: Which concepts, claims or problems of the earlier texts does the focal text take up?
Which tension, gap or objection left open by the earlier texts does the focal text answer?
Whom does the focal text argue with, and are those interlocutors inherited from the earlier texts or new?
Read only with what came before: is the focal text the culmination of the earlier agenda, a continuation of it, or a departure from it?

engine_name: The focal text as the culmination of what came before
problematique: Read the focal text knowing only what the author wrote before it: what it inherits from earlier texts (concepts, claims, problems), which earlier tension or problem it resolves, whom it argues with (inherited or new interlocutors), and whether it is the culmination of the earlier agenda, a continuation, or a departure from it. Nothing that came after is in view.
researcher_question: Read as if nothing followed: what does the focal text inherit, what does it resolve, and is it a culmination of what came before?
